title: 第11章 修复丹田第12章 真灵出现
slug: 师门不要我反手建个更强的
content_zh:
“什么九转丹师，不值得一提，你快去修复丹田吧，修复好之后赶紧修炼。”
韩自在把锅一收，双手一背，接着喝酒去了。
云星落拿着丹药来到雷池边，她是变异的雷灵根，修炼在雷池里最好不过了。
她盘膝而坐，把补天丹放入口中。
随着丹药入体，整个身体都暖和起来，原本破碎的丹田开始一点点修复，断掉的经脉也一根根连接起来。
短短三个时辰，云星落碎掉的丹田就修复如初。
让她惊喜的是，丹田修复之后并没有结束，而是一点点在扩大。
她原本的丹田，只有小水池那么大，不过两三个时辰的时间，已经扩大到湖泊那么大，浩瀚无边。
云星落从没想过，丹田还可以这么大。
随着丹田扩张完成，云星落的灵台也开始重建。
她丹田被废之前，修为是筑基二重。
修仙七大境界，炼气只是入门，筑基才是修仙的开始。
筑基就犹如盖房子打地基，地基打得越好，房子就越坚固，筑基亦是如此。
云星落当时筑基的时候为上品筑基，当时震惊了整个宗门，被封为宗门天才。
“此次丹田面积变大，希望能突破到天品筑基。”
云星落默默运转了功法。
就在云星落准备重新筑基的时候，识海之中，一道悠悠的声音响起。
“想不到我摘星宗还有后人，真是天助我也，本帝死而无憾了！”
“是谁，谁在这里？”
云星落四处观望，却是什么也没发现。

悠悠的声音依旧，“你不用看了，本帝已经死了很多年了，只有一缕残魂，你看不见的。”
“这缕残魂之所以不散，是因为还有执念在，如今斩魂把你带回摘星宗，你也开始修炼了，我想，这道执念应该可以消散了。”
“本帝？”
云星落消化着这声音的信息，突然间她想到了一个人，已经死了十万年的摘星大帝。
“你是摘星大帝？”
“丫头聪慧，斩魂没找错人。
既然你知道了，本帝有个请求，本帝想让你把本帝的功法传承下去。”
“请前辈指点！”
云星落不假思索就答应了，开玩笑，那可是大帝的功法啊！
古书上记载过，摘星大帝自创了一门独门功法，混沌星源诀。
此功法以混沌生星辰为理念，修炼出最本源的星源之力，可吞噬融合其他属性灵力，转化为自身星源之力。
修炼到大成后可随手创造星辰世界，成一方星辰之主。
她现在获得了太初圣图，虽然是契约了，但能不能发挥它最大的作用还另说。
content_en:
"What a nine-turn alchemist, it's not worth mentioning. Go and repair your dantian quickly. After repairing it, practice quickly."
Han Zizai put away the pot, put his hands behind his back, and went to drink.
Yun Xingluo came to the thunder pond with the elixir. She has a mutated thunder spirit root, and it is best to practice in the thunder pond.
She sat cross-legged and put the Tianbu Pill into her mouth.
As the elixir entered the body, the whole body warmed up, the originally broken Dantian began to repair bit by bit, and the broken meridians were connected one by one.
In just three hours, Yun Xingluo's broken Dantian was restored to its original state.
To her surprise, the repair of Dantian did not end, but expanded little by little.
Her original Dantian was only as big as a small pool, but within two or three hours, it had expanded to the size of a lake, vast and boundless.
Yun Xingluo never thought that Dantian could be so big.
With the expansion of Dantian completed, Yun Xingluo's spiritual platform also began to be rebuilt.
Before her Dantian was abolished, her cultivation was at the second level of Foundation Establishment.
Among the seven realms of cultivating immortality, refining Qi is just the beginning, and building foundation is the beginning of cultivating immortality.
Building a foundation is like building a house and laying a foundation. The better the foundation is, the stronger the house will be, and the same is true for building a foundation.
Yun Xingluo built the foundation for the top grade when he was building the foundation. At that time, he shocked the entire sect and was named a genius of the sect.
"This time the area of ​​the Dantian has become larger. I hope to break through to the Tianpin foundation."
Yun Xingluo silently operated the technique.
Just when Yun Xingluo was about to build the foundation again, a long voice sounded in the sea of ​​consciousness.
"I didn't expect that my Star Reaching Sect would still have descendants. God is really helping me. I will die with no regrets!"
"Who is it, who is here?"
Yun Xingluo looked around, but found nothing.
Youyou's voice remained the same, "You don't have to look, this emperor has been dead for many years, and there is only a trace of his soul that you can't see."
"The reason why this residual soul persists is because there is still an obsession. Now that Soul Slayer has brought you back to the Star Reaching Sect, and you have begun to practice, I think this obsession should be dissipated."
"This emperor?"
Yun Xingluo digested the information of this voice, and suddenly she thought of a person, the Star Reaching Emperor who had been dead for 100,000 years.
"Are you the Star Reaching Emperor?"
"Girl is smart, Zhanhun has found the right person.
Now that you know, I have a request. I want you to pass on my skills. "
"Senior, please give me some advice!"
Yun Xingluo agreed without hesitation. Just kidding, that's the Emperor's technique!
It is recorded in ancient books that the Star Reaching Emperor created his own unique technique, the Chaos Star Source Technique.
This technique is based on the concept of chaos birthing stars, cultivating the most original star source power, which can devour and fuse other attribute spiritual powers and transform it into the power of one's own star source.
After cultivating to great success, you can create a world of stars at will and become the lord of the stars.
She has now obtained the Holy Map of Taichu. Although it is a contract, it remains to be seen whether she can use it to its fullest effect.
